paragraphs.en: What is life? Like most great questions, this one is easy to ask but difficult to answer.We know of just one type of life and it's challenging to do science with a sample size of one.The field of artificial life—called ALife for short—seeks to {clone} and {simulate} life-like ( (栩栩如生的) ) processes in an attempt to spell out life's fundamental principles.Many of these {practitioners} , {so-called} ALifers, think that somehow creating life is the surest way to really understand what life is.
paragraphs.cn: 生命是什么？和大多数伟大的问题一样，这个问题问起来容易，回答起来却很难。我们只知道一种生命形式，而仅以这样一个样本进行科学研究颇具挑战性。人造生命领域（简称ALife）致力于 <u> 克隆 </u> 和 <u> 模拟 </u> 类似生命的过程，试图阐明生命的基本原理。许多该领域的 <u> 从业者 </u> ，即 <u> 所谓的 </u> 人造生命研究者，认为真正了解生命本质的最可靠的方法就是以某种方式创造生命。

paragraphs.en: So far, no one has {convincingly} made artificial life.This track record makes ALife a {ripe} target for {criticism} , such as {declarations} of the field's {doubtful} scientific value.Alan Smith, a {complexity} scientist, is {tired} of such {complaining} critics.“The {existence} of a living system is not about the use of anything.”Alan says.“Some people ask me,‘So what's the worth of artificial life?’Do you ever think,‘What is the worth of your {grandmother} ?’”
paragraphs.cn: 迄今为止，还没有人创造出 <u> 令人信服 </u> 的人造生命。这一过往表现使人造生命成为 <u> 众矢之的 </u> ， <u> 饱受批评 </u> ，比如有人 <u> 宣称 </u> 对该领域的科学价值存 <u> 疑 </u> 。 <u> 复杂性 </u> 科学家艾伦·史密斯对这些 <u> 抱怨连连 </u> 的批评者感到 <u> 厌烦 </u> 。艾伦说：“生命系统的 <u> 存在 </u> 无关乎任何用途。有些人问我，‘那人造生命有什么价值呢？’你有没有想过，‘你的 <u> 祖母 </u> 有什么价值呢？’”

paragraphs.en: As much as many ALifers {hate} {emphasizing} their research's applications, the attempts to create artificial life could have practical {pay-offs} .Artificial intelligence may be considered ALife's {cousin} in that researchers in both fields are enamored ( (使倾心) ) by a {prospect} called {open-ended} evolution.This is the capacity for a system to create {essentially} {endless} complexity, to be a {sort} of“ {novelty} {generator} ”.The only system known to exhibit this is Earth's {biosphere} .If the field of ALife manages to {reproduce} life's endless “creativity” in some virtual model, those same principles could give rise to truly {inventive} {machines} .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管许多人造生命研究者 <u> 不喜欢强调 </u> 其研究的实用性，但创造人造生命的尝试可能会带来实际 <u> 收益 </u> 。人工智能可以说是人造生命的 <u> 近亲 </u> ，因为这两个领域的研究人员都对被称为“ <u> 开放式 </u> 进化”的 <u> 前景 </u> 着迷。 <u> 本质上来说 </u> ，这是一个系统创造 <u> 无穷无尽 </u> 复杂性的能力，就像是一 <u> 种 </u> “ <u> 新事物生成器 </u> ”。目前唯一已知的展现出这种能力的系统就是地球的 <u> 生物圈 </u> 。如果人造生命领域能够在某些虚拟模型中 <u> 重现 </u> 生命无尽的“创造力”，那么同样的原理可能会用于开发真正 <u> 具有创造力的机器 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Compared with the developments in Al, advances in ALife are harder to recognize.One reason is that ALife is a field in which the central concept—life itself—is {undefined} .The lack of {agreement} among ALifers doesn't help either.Some think it's enough for a system to be called “life” if it can {import} energy, {export} waste, and evolve over time.Others may look {backward} at traditional definitions and stick to stricter standards.The result is a diverse line of projects that each advances along its unique path.For better or worse, ALife mirrors the very subject it studies.Its muddled ( (混乱的) ) {progression} is a striking parallel to the evolutionary struggles that have shaped Earth biosphere.
paragraphs.cn: 与人工智能的发展相比，人造生命领域的进展更难察觉。其中一个原因是，人造生命领域的核心概念，即生命本身，尚 <u> 无定论 </u> 。人造生命研究者之间缺乏 <u> 共识 </u> 也是一个原因。有些人认为，如果一个系统能够 <u> 输入 </u> 能量、 <u> 排出 </u> 废物，并随时间不断进化，就足以被称为“生命”。另一些人则会参照传统定义，坚持更严格的标准。结果就是一系列各不相同的项目沿着各自独特的路径发展。无论好坏，人造生命领域都反映了它所研究的主题。它混乱的 <u> 发展过程 </u> 与塑造地球生物圈的进化斗争惊人地相似。

paragraphs.en: As the field continues to evolve, each new {episode} of research brings fresh insights.Undefined and {uncontrolled} , ALife has forced us to {separate} concepts considered to be characteristics of life and examine them more carefully.It may be, of course, that these characteristics aren't in any way surprising or {singular} .They may apply {universally} to all acts of evolution.Ultimately ALife may be nothing special.But even this {dismissal} suggests something: perhaps, just like life itself throughout the universe, the rise of ALife will prove {unavoidable} .
paragraphs.cn: 随着这一领域的不断发展，每一 <u> 项 </u> 新的研究都会带来新的见解。人造生命领域既无明确界定，也 <u> 不受控制 </u> ，这迫使我们将那些被认为是生命特征的概念区 <u> 分开 </u> ，并对其进行更仔细的研究。当然，这些特征可能并不令人惊讶，也并非 <u> 独一无二 </u> 。它们可能 <u> 普遍 </u> 适用于所有的进化过程。最终，人造生命可能并无特别之处。但即使这种 <u> 否定 </u> 也暗示了某种道理——也许，就像宇宙中的生命本身一样，人造生命的兴起将 <u> 不可避免 </u> 。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
